_note: Demo rooms. Each room: name, desc, optional bg (a plate id -> assets/backgrounds_hd/<bg>.png), exits (west/north/south/east -> room id), and optional npcs, pickups, shop, net, matrix, on_enter_flag, requires_flag/locked_text. No bg here so the demo runs art-free.

foyer.name: Foyer
foyer.desc: A dim entry hall with a cold hearth and a staircase going nowhere anyone remembers. A quiet figure — the guide — waits by the banister. A doorway opens to the east.

study.name: Study
study.desc: Walls of books gone soft with damp, and a writing desk with one locked drawer. On the blotter, catching what little light there is, lies a brass key.
